descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Cozy Kitchen 2 is the bigger, busier sequel to Cozy Kitchen - a relaxing restaurant game for Meta Quest where everything is done with your hands.

AN OPEN KITCHEN
No wall between you and your guests. Regulars sit on bar stools right across your chef's counter and watch you cook, while knights, mages, rangers and friendly skeletons fill the dining room.

A BIGGER MENU
Burgers, cheeseburgers, veggie burgers and the Deluxe, garden salads, stew, ham dinners, steak with mash, crispy fries, lemonade and cola.

NEW STATIONS
Grill four patties at once, drop raw fries in the deep fryer, and stand a glass under the drinks machine - it pours by itself. Chop on big boards and stack on a plate; every layer snaps into place.

MEAL + DRINK ORDERS
Guests often want a drink with their meal and start eating once both arrive.

THE FOOD CRITIC
Serve the critic quickly for a rave review, a bonus star and a big tip.

GROW YOUR RESTAURANT
Spend tips on upgrades you can see: a sunny patio, hot burners, comfy cushions, a jukebox, flowers and art, and a neon sign.

CAREER OR FREE MODE
Career unlocks dishes day by day and earns stars. Free Mode has no clock - everything is open.

Grip to pick up, left stick to walk, right stick to turn. No violence, no failing - just cooking.
